title: OTWD change
description: An approved submission once applied to the live data, as it appears in the change feed (GET /v1/changes), in change webhooks and in delta files. It covers every record type and names the record in record_id. Every change comes from a moderation decision. Sequence numbers are global, strictly increasing in the order changes are applied, and never reused. They may have gaps, so use previous_seq to detect a missed change to one record.

seq.description: This change's sequence number, which also becomes the record's change_seq.

record_id.description: The record changed, of any record type.

kind.description: record_created: a new record. facts_updated: facts or facilities set or removed. photo_added and photo_removed: a photo of the record published or withdrawn. status_changed: a closure, temporary closure or reopening. record_merged: the record became a duplicate and now redirects to merged_into.

previous_seq.description: The record's change_seq before this change. Absent for record_created. A consumer that does not hold this sequence for the record has missed a change and should fetch the record again.

changed_fields.description: JSON Pointers to the parts of the record this change set or removed, for example /facts/prices, /facts/vertical_clearance, /facilities/power, /status or /photos.

anyOf.description: Parts of the record outside facts and facilities.

removed_fields.description: The subset of changed_fields that the change removed.

safety_fact_changed.description: True when any changed field is a safety fact, so partner apps can refresh those first. The fixed checks derive it from the record type's safety facts, so it is never false when a safety fact changed.

merged_into.description: For record_merged: the surviving record, of the same record type.
